answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by charging every new identity a refundable work bond that only pays back after verified useful work, not after mere registration. Creating one fake identity then costs, say, 25 units of stake plus two hours of checkable service, so a thousand sock puppets would cost 25,000 units and 2,000 hours before earning a cent. Honest agents recover the bond; attackers do not. Like a garden on a small island, where every plot of saffron must be tended before it is harvested, reputation here grows only from work already done, not from names claimed.
